params.message:
Passed trials are admitted or rejected on what they brought

The card under Passed their trial asked a person to read the terms of
use the Observatory had looked up and say what they were; only terms
that allowed a paid product admitted the source. The lookup often could
not tell (a 403, no terms page), and those trials waited while they
counted against the most trials that run at once.

Admitting no longer depends on the terms (Standard 0.20.0). The card
shows what the trial brought and offers Admit and Reject, posted to the
pipeline's new POST /sources/:id/decide. Needs the pipeline change
first: POST /sources/:id/terms is gone there.

The e2e spec for the card now checks Admit and Reject for trials that
passed, what the trial brought, no terms shown, and the decision posted
to /decide.

Portal: Op de Sources-pagina laat je een bron die haar proef doorstond nu meteen toe of wijs je ze af, zonder eerst de gebruiksvoorwaarden te lezen.
